message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate crime(s) based on facts. The case involves false issuance of VAT special invoices (增值税专用发票) without real transaction, i.e.,虚开增值税专用发票. Also there is tax evasion (逃税) because they didn't declare tax and evaded tax. The facts: they opened false invoices for 6250 tons of corn, amount 9,968,750 yuan, tax 1,146,847 yuan, collected fee 125,000 yuan. They also didn't declare tax on sales revenue of 1,898,508.31 yuan, evading 322,236.41 yuan. So charges: 虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票 (the label used earlier for similar case). Also 逃税. The list includes both: "虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票" and "逃税". So answer should be both separated by semicolon.

Thus final answer: [罪名]虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票;逃税<eoa>
